lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam saadhoo saranaaee ||
lines.translation: In the Sanctuary of the Holy, chant the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bachanee gat mit paaee ||
lines.translation: Through the True Guru's Teachings, one comes to know His state and extent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੩॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har jap har man mere har mele melanahaaraa he ||17||3||9||
lines.translation: Nanak: chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; the Lord, the Uniter, shall unite you with Himself. ||17||3||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਰਹੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੁਗਧ ਇਆਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar rahu re man mugadh iaane ||
lines.translation: Remain in your own home, O my foolish and ignorant mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਧਿਆਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam japahu a(n)taragat dhiaane ||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Lord - concentrate deep within your being and meditate on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚ ਛੋਡਿ ਰਚਹੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਇਉ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: laalach chhod rachahu apara(n)par iu paavahu mukat duaaraa he ||1||
lines.translation: Renounce your greed, and merge with the infinite Lord. In this way, you shall find the door of liberation. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਿਐ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਣਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis bisariai jam johan laagai ||
lines.translation: If you forget Him, the Messenger of Death will catch sight of you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਦੁਖਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh sukh jaahi dukhaa phun aagai ||
lines.translation: All peace will be gone, and you will suffer in pain in the world hereafter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਏਹੁ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam jap guramukh jeeaRe ehu param tat veechaaraa he ||2||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord as Gurmukh, O my soul; this is the supreme essence of contemplation. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu ras meethaa ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the sweetest essence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh har ras a(n)tar deethaa ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, see the essence of the Lord deep within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਹਹੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਏਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ahinis raam rahahu ra(n)g raate ehu jap tap sa(n)jam saaraa he ||3||
lines.translation: Day and night, remain imbued with the Lord's Love. This is the essence of all chanting, deep meditation and self-discipline. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਬੋਲਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam gur bachanee bolahu ||
lines.translation: Speak the Guru's Word, and the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਟੋਲਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t sabhaa mahi ihu ras tolahu ||
lines.translation: In the Society of the Saints, search for this essence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਗਰਭ ਮਝਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: guramat khoj lahahu ghar apanaa bahuR na garabh majhaaraa he ||4||
lines.translation: Follow the Guru's Teachings - seek and find the home of your own self, and you shall never be consigned to the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach teerath naavahu har gun gaavahu ||
lines.translation: Bathe at the sacred shrine of Truth, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tat veechaarahu har liv laavahu ||
lines.translation: Reflect upon the essence of reality, and lovingly focus your consciousness on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t kaal jam johi na saakai har bolahu raam piaaraa he ||5||
lines.translation: At the very last moment, the Messenger of Death will not be able to touch you, if you chant the Name of the Beloved Lord. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur purakh daataa vad daanaa ||
lines.translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, the Great Giver, is all-knowing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis a(n)tar saach s sabad samaanaa ||
lines.translation: Whoever has Truth within himself, merges in the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਭੈ ਭਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jis kau satigur mel milaae tis chookaa jam bhai bhaaraa he ||6||
lines.translation: One whom the True Guru unites in Union, is rid of the overpowering fear of death. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch tat mil kaaiaa keenee ||
lines.translation: The body is formed from the union of the five elements.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਲੈ ਚੀਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis mahi raam ratan lai cheenee ||
lines.translation: Know that the Lord's jewel is within it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: aatam raam raam hai aatam har paaeeai sabad veechaaraa he ||7||
lines.translation: The soul is the Lord, and the Lord is the soul; contemplating the Shabad, the Lord is found. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh rahahu jan bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Abide in truth and contentment, O humble Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਮਾ ਗਹਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: khimaa gahahu satigur saranaaee ||
lines.translation: Hold tight to compassion and the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਪਰਾਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: aatam cheen paraatam cheenahu gur sa(n)gat ihu nisataaraa he ||8||
lines.translation: Know your soul, and know the Supreme Soul; associating with the Guru, you shall be emancipated. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜ ਕਪਟ ਮਹਿ ਟੇਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat kooR kapat mahi tekaa ||
lines.translation: The faithless cynics are stuck in falsehood and deceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ahinis ni(n)daa karahi anekaa ||
lines.translation: Day and night, they slander many others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਰਕ ਮਝਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: bin simaran aavahi phun jaavahi grabh jonee narak majhaaraa he ||9||
lines.translation: Without meditative remembrance, they come and then go, and are cast into the hellish womb of reincarnation. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat jam kee kaan na chookai ||
lines.translation: The faithless cynic is not rid of his fear of death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਮੂਕੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam kaa da(n)d na kabahoo mookai ||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death's club is never taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਕੀ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਅਫਰਿਓ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: baakee dharam raai kee leejai sir aphario bhaar aphaaraa he ||10||
lines.translation: He has to answer to the Righteous Judge of Dharma for the account of his actions; the egotistical being carries the unbearable load. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur saakat kahahu ko tariaa ||
lines.translation: Tell me: without the Guru, what faithless cynic has been saved?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai karataa bhavajal pariaa ||
lines.translation: Acting egotistically, he falls into the terrifying world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur paar na paavai koee har japeeai paar utaaraa he ||11||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, no one is saved; meditating on the Lord, they are carried across to the other side. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee daat na metai koee ||
lines.translation: No one can erase the Guru's blessings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis bakhase tis taare soee ||
lines.translation: The Lord carries across those whom He forgives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran dukh neR na aavai man so prabh apar apaaraa he ||12||
lines.translation: The pains of birth and death do not even approach those whose minds are filled with God, the infinite and endless. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਆਵਹੁ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur te bhoole aavahu jaavahu ||
lines.translation: Those who forget the Guru come and go in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam marahu phun paap kamaavahu ||
lines.translation: They are born, only to die again, and continue committing sins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਅਚੇਤ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: saakat mooR achet na chetahi dukh laagai taa raam pukaaraa he ||13||
lines.translation: The unconscious, foolish, faithless cynic does not remember the Lord; but when he is stricken with pain, then he cries out for the Lord. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh dukh purab janam ke keee ||
lines.translation: Pleasure and pain are the consequences of the actions of past lives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਦੀਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: so jaanai jin daatai deee ||
lines.translation: The Giver, who blesses us with these - He alone knows.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਦੋਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸਹੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: kis kau dos dehi too praanee sahu apanaa keeaa karaaraa he ||14||
lines.translation: So who can you blame, O mortal being? The hardships you suffer are from your own actions. ||14||
